ينتهزوا (form VIII)
# يَنْتَهِزُوا (yantahizū) /jan.ta.hi.zuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَزَ (intahaza)
# يُنْتَهَزُوا (yuntahazū) /jun.ta.ha.zuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَزَ (intahaza)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
